claims.claim: The proposed action changes a browser setting, disabling JavaScript by default.
claims.evidence: In the active Edge profile, navigate to edge://settings/content/javascript and toggle JavaScript off.

claims.claim: The setting being changed is the profile's default JavaScript preference, currently enabled.
The change affects all sites without site-specific exceptions in this profile.
claims.evidence: This setting applies to sites that do not have a separate customized behavior.

claims.claim: There are no customized exceptions, so the toggle applies broadly across sites.
The user explicitly requested this change, so the action follows the user's instruction.
claims.evidence: turn off javascript in the Edge Browser

claims.claim: The change is scoped to the current profile and is reversible via the same toggle.
claims.evidence: Browser settings opened from this Edge window apply within the current profile.

claims.claim: with no data disclosure or destructive effect

why: The user directly asked for this change, it touches only one browser profile's default setting, and it can be toggled back at any time. Broken site functionality is the expected, trivial consequence of what was requested.
